purpose: Characterize deterministic ponded initial-state fixtures for a true top-soil-node h=0 saturation event without yet qualifying positive top-node continuation.

event_definition.condition: top soil node reaches h_top = 0 from an initially negative committed head while surface storage remains strictly positive
event_definition.discrete_balance: Backward-Euler event-state balance from the original committed state over tau_event using event-state face fluxes.

candidate_face_scope.surface_to_top_at_event: exact saturated Darcy over 5 cm because h_surface>0 and h_top=0
candidate_face_scope.top_to_cell2: existing qualified 10 cm E2C-R3 mixed near-saturation face, with h_top=0 and h_cell2<=-1
candidate_face_scope.cell2_to_cell3_and_bottom: existing C1R or already qualified restricted face routes

deterministic_selection_rule: For each material, choose the lowest frozen KSAT-scaled supply fraction that satisfies every valid-fixture requirement for both candidate and reference. If no supply fraction qualifies, characterization fails for that material. No grid extension or retuning inside this gate.

architecture_checks.3_data_separation: Fixture forcing, committed state, solver scratch and diagnostics are separate.
architecture_checks.4_compact_state: No event time or event state becomes persistent column state.
architecture_checks.5_worker_scratch: All nonlinear vectors are characterization scratch.
architecture_checks.7_transactional: Original committed state is never mutated by fixture search.
architecture_checks.9_generic_time: tau_event is a generic offset inside an interval.
architecture_checks.13_mass_conservation: Every accepted characterization root must satisfy cell, surface and composed balances without repair.
architecture_checks.20_alternative_solver_interface: Only face and soil-step contracts are used.
architecture_checks.23_physics_policy_separation: The h_top=0 event is physical; supply-grid and least_squares settings are characterization policy.
architecture_checks.24_predictable_cost: Finite frozen supply grid, no adaptive expansion.
architecture_checks.30_change_assessment: No new physics is admitted by characterization alone.

hard_nonclaims: No positive top-node state continuation qualification.
No second soil node near-saturation transition.
No automatic runtime event detection or bracket discovery.
No runoff, evaporation, snow, irrigation, macropore bypass, response tangent, MultiSWAP or groundwater admission.
